published_benchmark.title: Published ADAM-1 Paper Benchmark
published_benchmark.description: Results published in the ADAM-1 research paper (IEEE Access, 2025) aggregated across 30 independent experiment runs.
published_benchmark.sample_protocol: Balanced test sets (15 Alzheimer's vs 15 Controls per seed, N=30)

adam.notes: Published ADAM-1 Paper 30-seed benchmark (F1: 0.7263 ± 0.0632). Precision/Recall not recorded in paper CSV.

xgboost.notes: Published ADAM-1 Paper 30-seed baseline (F1: 0.6774 ± 0.1217). Precision/Recall not recorded in paper CSV.

current_evaluation.title: Current ADAM-1 Enhanced Results
current_evaluation.description: Live dynamic evaluation on current test cohort (Natural Cohort Prevalence, N=93 samples, seed=42).

xgboost.notes: Evaluated live on current full_cohort test split (N=93).

randomforest.notes: Evaluated live on current full_cohort test split (N=93).

logisticregression.notes: Evaluated live on current full_cohort test split (N=93).

adam.notes: Evaluated via paper-conformant multi-agent reasoning (Classification Agent: deterministic_consensus) on current full_cohort test split (N=93, seed=42). ADAM achieved 87.1% Recall with 5 error-corrections over base XGBoost.
